rule.statement: A person nominated to succeed to a state land can continue with the action under section 404 of the Civil Procedure Code.
rule.supporting_quote: On the facts of the present case, it was open to the 2nd Respondent to continue with the action or as was done for the 1st Respondent to seek leave of court to be substituted in place of the 2nd Respondent.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 404 of the Civil Procedure Code
